summary_md: **Alex Korotin ([@iamalexkorotin](https://x.com/iamalexkorotin/status/2115822543646900247))** built **Tough AI Paper Reviewer**, a large prompt for Claude Code or Codex in which eight sub-agents check a paper's proofs, experiments and novelty against relevant literature before submission ([iamalexkorotin/ToughAIPaperReviewer](https://github.com/iamalexkorotin/ToughAIPaperReviewer)).
